title: Click interface tests by instance path, and send multi-press actions in one sequence
observation: Studio MCP mouse coordinates taken from a screenshot did not land where expected (the click hit a modal's backdrop and closed the window), while user_mouse_input with an instance_path clicked the intended buttons reliably once the buttons had unique names. A two-press purchase confirmation with a 3 s window also failed when the second click was sent in a separate MCP call: the round trip took longer than the window, so the click re-armed instead of buying; sending both clicks in one input sequence worked.
recommendation: Give interactive UI objects unique names and drive tests by instance_path; put every step of a timed multi-press interaction in one input sequence; and size human confirmation windows generously (this game moved to 5 s).
applies_when: Testing a Roblox interface through Studio MCP input tools
An interaction needs two presses within a time window
limits: One Windows PC and one Studio window size in October 2026
Touch and gamepad input were not driven this way

evidence.detail: Sections 16 and 22, and GAME_DESIGN.md V11 lessons (3) and (4).
